what_this_is: The programs that run a speech model on a person's Mac and the engines they run (kinds speech-program and speech-engine), read by computer/speak.mjs. A `speech-program` is tried in order (the first whose `check` answers, its program found on `search_path`) and its `run` starts the resident speaker; a `speech-engine` names the model, what it takes (a reference voice or a neutral one) and what it was measured at. The shared voices, the speaker's timings, the loudness and the words stay in computer/speak.json. A new engine is a new row.

payload.label: Qwen3-TTS
payload._measured: 2026-10-07 on an M5 Max at load average about 36: a 7.5 s sentence in a cloned voice took 9.6-12.7 s with the model loaded (26 s the first time); streamed, its first sound came after 0.54 s at a real-time factor of 0.95. Cloned from a reference that ends on a sentence end, every take transcribed word for word.

payload.label: Kokoro
payload._measured: 2026-10-07 on the same Mac: an 8.2 s sentence took 0.63-1.6 s with the model loaded (real-time factor 0.08-0.2, about 16-20 s the first time), word for word, no clipping.
